summary: Female tuber caught in a tree strainer about 1/4 mile east of N. Overland Trail on the Cache la Poudre River in NW Fort Collins; rescue swimmers, a boat and rope-rigging freed her; she was evaluated on scene and transported by ambulance to Poudre Valley Hospital.
location: Cache la Poudre River ~1/4 mi E of N. Overland Trail, NW Fort Collins
responding_agency: Larimer County Sheriff's Office; LCSO Emergency Services; Larimer County Dive Rescue Team; Poudre Valley Hospital EMS
